issue.title: Add `ignore_throttled` parameter support to `_msearch` API (#35851)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This PR adds `ignore_throttled` parameter support to the `_msearch` API.

When an `ignore_throttled` boolean parameter is passed as a request parameter, it is now set in each inner request indices options.

See #35851.

body: Hi, I've opened PR #35903 to fix this issue, could you please give it a review? Thanks.

issue.title: Respect indices options on _msearch

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Today we don't respect the indices options when they are passed
as request parameters to the _msearch endpoint. This is unintutive
and doesn't cause any errors. This changes uses the top-level indices
options as the defaults for each sub-searchrequest.

body: I've closed #35903, as #35887 by @s1monw add support for all indices options (not only `ignore_throttled`).
